data.name: autarkize
data.description: Autarkize is a German climate-tech startup based in Pfronten/Allgäu that develops containerized pyrolysis plants converting biogenic residues (wood waste, digestate, sewage sludge, green waste) into pyrolysis gas and certified biochar. The biochar serves as a permanent CO2 sink eligible for CDR certificates, with plants sized to remove roughly 1,000–5,500 tonnes of CO2 per year.
